title: 3770. Largest Prime from Consecutive Prime Sum

examples.explanation: The prime numbers less than or equal to n = 20 which are consecutive prime sums are: 2 = 2 5 = 2 + 3 17 = 2 + 3 + 5 + 7 The largest is 17, so it is the answer.
The only consecutive prime sum less than or equal to 2 is 2 itself.
